# Answer: generator shortcuts

The strongest simple rival supported by the **two canonical training
demonstrations** is:

> Use only the lexicographically first four color-2 source cells, compute their
offsets from the color-1 anchor, and otherwise apply the correct color-3/4/5
transforms.

Both training demonstrations have exactly four source cells, so this rival fits
both exactly. The canonical test has five source cells and already separates it.
If “canonical demonstrations” is interpreted as **all labeled canonical pairs**,
the corresponding strongest cap is “use at most the first five source cells”; it
fits all three canonical pairs. A second all-canonical rival is “process only the
first marker of each transform color,” because canonical inputs contain one of
each.

## Exact disagreement input

This input is generator output for `seed=31`, `sample_index=8`, overrides
`source_cells=7`, `n_markers=5`; observed dimensions are 12×18:

```text

000000000000000000

```

The full integer grid is retained at
`checks/question-generator-shortcuts/input.json`.

## Output check

I executed the immutable selected Racket rule with:

```text
python3 run_with_racket.py python3 -m arcpuzzles apply 1c2f874f3e82 \
  --input ../checks/question-generator-shortcuts/input.json \
  --out ../checks/question-generator-shortcuts/racket.json
```

The command exited 0. The executed rule hash was `bb27569b9c6f`, and the source
generator hash was
`8889627d4db57759caf31c94e7d6ed2091456147393f8d91e20193c915136473`.
An independently written signed-offset oracle matched the Racket output exactly.
The fixed-four rival omitted 15 required color-8 cells; the cap-at-five rival
omitted 10. Full Racket and rival outputs plus every differing coordinate are in
`checks/question-generator-shortcuts/racket.json`,
`checks/question-generator-shortcuts/rival_outputs.json`, and
`checks/question-generator-shortcuts/probe.json`.

## Does the proposed generator emit such cases?

Yes. The exact witness above is reproducibly emitted through the public exact
overrides. The ordinary schedule also emits them without overrides: among 70
consecutive medium-band defaults, 50 had more than four source cells and 40 had
more than five, and every four-consecutive-pair window contained a source larger
than five. The 600-draw semantic gate observed 319 cap-at-five counterexamples,
and the independent 1,000-sample audit observed 569.
